points.title: 北非童年
points.description: 德里达出生于阿尔及利亚的比斯克拉，一个犹太裔家庭。他的童年处于法国殖民统治下的阿尔及利亚，这段经历深刻影响了他的思想形成。尽管是法国公民，但作为犹太人在殖民地的双重身份使他很早就开始思考边缘性、差异性和权力结构的问题。1940年，维希政府实施反犹法律，德里达被学校开除，这段经历强化了他对权威和排他性思想的批判意识。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Biskra, Algeria to a Jewish family, Derrida's childhood under French colonial rule profoundly shaped his intellectual development. His dual identity as both a French citizen and a Jew in colonial Algeria led him early to questions of marginality, difference, and power structures. In 1940, Vichy anti-Semitic laws led to his expulsion from school, an experience that reinforced his critical stance toward authority and exclusionary thought.

points.title: 哲学启蒙
points.description: 德里达移居巴黎，进入著名的路易大帝中学(Lycée Louis-le-Grand)预备班，随后考入巴黎高等师范学院(École Normale Supérieure)。在这里，他受到现象学、存在主义和结构主义的影响，师从让·伊波利特(Jean Hyppolite)和路易·阿尔都塞(Louis Althusser)等著名哲学家。这一时期，德里达开始系统阅读胡塞尔、海德格尔、尼采等人的著作，形成了自己独特的哲学思考方式，为后来的解构主义奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Moving to Paris, Derrida attended the prestigious Lycée Louis-le-Grand and then the École Normale Supérieure. There, he was influenced by phenomenology, existentialism, and structuralism, studying under philosophers like Jean Hyppolite and Louis Althusser. During this period, Derrida systematically read Husserl, Heidegger, Nietzsche, and others, developing his unique philosophical approach that would later form the foundation of deconstruction.

points.title: 学术起步
points.description: 德里达在阿尔及利亚短暂任教后返回法国，在巴黎高师担任助教。这一时期，他完成了关于胡塞尔现象学的研究，并于1962年出版第一部重要著作《胡塞尔〈几何学的起源〉导论》。同时，他开始与列维-斯特劳斯、福柯、巴特等结构主义思想家交往，但逐渐对结构主义的确定性提出质疑。1964年，德里达发表《论文字学》，标志着他正式与结构主义决裂，提出了解构主义的核心思想，挑战了西方哲学传统中言语优于文字的等级观念。
points.descriptionEn: After briefly teaching in Algeria, Derrida returned to France as an assistant at the École Normale Supérieure. During this period, he completed his research on Husserlian phenomenology and published his first major work, 'Introduction to the Origin of Geometry' in 1962. He began associating with structuralist thinkers like Lévi-Strauss, Foucault, and Barthes, but increasingly questioned structuralist certainties. In 1964, Derrida published 'Of Grammatology', formally breaking with structuralism and articulating core deconstructive ideas that challenged the Western philosophical tradition's privileging of speech over writing.

points.title: 解构主义崛起
points.description: 1967年是德里达学术生涯的关键一年，他同时出版了三部奠基性著作：《文字与差异》、《论文字学》和《语音与现象》。这些著作确立了他在哲学界的地位，解构主义开始产生广泛影响。在巴黎高师任教期间，德里达吸引了来自世界各地的学生，包括保罗·德·曼、希利斯·米勒等美国学者。他开始频繁访问美国，在耶鲁大学、约翰·霍普金斯大学等机构讲学，将解构主义引入美国学术界。这一时期，德里达的思想从哲学扩展到文学、法学、政治学等多个领域，形成了跨学科的影响力。
points.descriptionEn: 1967 proved pivotal for Derrida's career with the publication of three foundational works: 'Writing and Difference', 'Of Grammatology', and 'Speech and Phenomenon'. These works established his position in philosophy, and deconstruction began to exert wide influence. Teaching at the École Normale Supérieure, Derrida attracted students from around the world, including Americans Paul de Man and J. Hillis Miller. He began frequent visits to the United States, lecturing at Yale, Johns Hopkins, and other institutions, introducing deconstruction to American academia. During this period, his thought expanded from philosophy to literature, law, politics, and other fields, creating interdisciplinary impact.

points.title: 全球影响
points.description: 1980年代后，德里达的学术影响力扩展至全球。他担任巴黎高师哲学系主任，同时在美国多所大学担任客座教授，包括加州大学欧文分校和纽约社会研究新学院。这一时期，德里达的思想更加政治化，关注种族、性别、殖民主义等议题。他出版《马克思的幽灵》、《他者的单语主义》等著作，将解构主义应用于政治伦理领域。1990年代，德里达积极参与国际政治讨论，如南非种族隔离、巴尔干冲突等，展现出知识分子的公共关怀。他的著作被翻译成数十种语言，解构主义成为人文社科领域的重要方法论。
points.descriptionEn: After 1980, Derrida's academic influence expanded globally. He served as director of philosophy at the École Normale Supérieure while holding visiting professorships at multiple American universities, including UC Irvine and the New School for Social Research. During this period, his thought became more politically engaged, addressing race, gender, and colonialism. He published works like 'Specters of Marx' and 'Monolingualism of the Other', applying deconstruction to political and ethical domains. In the 1990s, Derrida actively participated in international political discussions on issues like South African apartheid and Balkan conflicts, demonstrating intellectual public engagement. His works were translated into dozens of languages, and deconstruction became a significant methodology in humanities and social sciences.

points.title: 晚年思想
points.description: 晚年德里达的思想更加关注宗教、伦理和政治议题。2001年，他发表《论信仰的暴力》，探讨宗教与政治的关系。2003年，他出版《动物因此我思》，挑战人类中心主义，思考动物伦理问题。同年，德里达发起'关于欧洲宪章的民主论坛'，积极参与欧洲一体化讨论。2004年，德里达因胰腺癌在巴黎去世，享年74岁。他的晚年思想呈现出对政治伦理的更多关注，同时保持了其解构主义的核心立场，继续质疑任何形式的绝对真理和确定性。德里达去世后，他的思想遗产继续影响着当代哲学、文学、政治理论等多个领域。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Derrida's thought increasingly focused on religion, ethics, and politics. In 2001, he published 'On the Force of Law', exploring the relationship between religion and politics. In 2003, he published 'The Animal That Therefore I Am', challenging anthropocentrism and considering animal ethics. The same year, Derrida initiated 'The Democracy to Come' forum on the European Constitution, actively engaging in discussions about European integration. Derrida died of pancreatic cancer in Paris in 2004 at age 74. His later thought showed greater concern for political ethics while maintaining his core deconstructive stance, continuing to question any form of absolute truth and certainty. After his death, Derrida's intellectual legacy continues to influence contemporary philosophy, literature, political theory, and other fields.

appraisal.zh: 德里达被公认为20世纪最具原创性的哲学家之一，其解构主义挑战西方传统的二元对立与等级结构，为人文学科开辟跨学科的知识生产方式，并被边缘群体与少数话语引为理论资源，深刻影响文学批评、文化研究与法学理论。也有研究者指出，其思想晦涩而缺乏明确方法论，导致解读的任意性，对传统的全盘否定忽视了既有价值，并可能滑向相对主义与虚无主义，过分聚焦语言文本则脱离现实，文风亦自我指涉。争议之中，他仍是后现代理论的核心人物。
appraisal.en: Derrida is widely recognized as one of the most original philosophers of the twentieth century: deconstruction challenged the binary oppositions and hierarchies of the Western tradition, opened interdisciplinary modes of knowledge in the humanities, and was taken up on behalf of marginalized groups and minority discourses, deeply influencing literary criticism, cultural studies and legal theory. Researchers also point out that his thought is obscure and lacks clear method, inviting arbitrary readings, that his wholesale rejection of tradition overlooks its positive values, that it risks relativism and nihilism, and that his focus on language and text is detached from material reality, his style self-referential. Amid the controversy he remains a central figure of postmodern theory.

supporter.zh: 德里达被誉为20世纪最具原创性和影响力的哲学家之一。他的解构主义彻底改变了人文社科领域的思维方式，挑战了西方哲学传统中的二元对立和等级结构。支持者认为，德里达的思想为边缘群体和少数话语提供了理论武器，促进了文化多元主义和批判理论的发展。他的跨学科方法打破了哲学与文学、法学、政治学等领域的界限，创造了新的知识生产方式。德里达对语言、文本和意义的深刻分析，至今仍是当代思想的重要资源。
supporter.en: Derrida is celebrated as one of the most original and influential philosophers of the 20th century. His deconstruction fundamentally transformed thinking in the humanities and social sciences, challenging binary oppositions and hierarchical structures in Western philosophical tradition. Supporters argue that his theory provided intellectual weapons for marginalized groups and minority discourses, promoting cultural pluralism and critical theory. His interdisciplinary approach broke down boundaries between philosophy and literature, law, politics, and other fields, creating new modes of knowledge production. Derrida's profound analysis of language, text, and meaning remains a vital resource in contemporary thought.

critic.zh: 批评者认为德里达的解构主义存在严重缺陷。首先，其思想被认为过于晦涩难懂，缺乏明确的方法论，导致解读上的任意性。其次，批评者指出德里达对西方传统的全盘否定忽视了哲学传统的积极价值。第三，有人质疑解构主义的政治实践效果，认为它可能导致相对主义和虚无主义，削弱了道德和政治行动的基础。此外，德里达对语言和文本的过度关注被批评为脱离现实世界，忽视了物质条件和历史结构的决定性作用。他的写作风格也受到批评，被认为过于复杂和自我指涉，阻碍了思想的传播和交流。
critic.en: Critics argue that Derrida's deconstruction suffers from significant flaws. First, his thought is considered excessively obscure and lacking clear methodology, leading to arbitrary interpretations. Second, critics contend that Derrida's wholesale rejection of Western tradition overlooks the positive values of philosophical heritage. Third, some question the political efficacy of deconstruction, suggesting it may lead to relativism and nihilism that undermine the foundations of moral and political action. Additionally, Derrida's excessive focus on language and text is criticized for being disconnected from the real world, neglecting the determining role of material conditions and historical structures. His writing style has also been faulted for being overly complex and self-referential, hindering the dissemination and communication of ideas.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，德里达被定位为后现代主义理论的核心人物之一。他的思想深刻影响了文学批评、文化研究、法学理论等领域，成为学术界的标志性人物。德里达的解构主义既被视为一种方法论，也被理解为一种哲学立场和文化批判。在流行文化中，他的名字常与复杂性、不确定性和对权威的挑战联系在一起。尽管存在争议，德里达的思想遗产已融入当代学术话语，成为理解现代性和后现代性不可或缺的视角。他的生平和作品反映了20世纪后期知识分子从学院哲学走向公共领域的转变过程。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Derrida is positioned as one of the central figures of postmodern theory. His thought has profoundly influenced literary criticism, cultural studies, legal theory, and other fields, making him an iconic figure in academia. Deconstruction is viewed both as a methodology and as a philosophical stance and cultural critique. In popular culture, his name is often associated with complexity, uncertainty, and challenge to authority. Despite controversies, Derrida's intellectual legacy has been integrated into contemporary academic discourse, becoming an indispensable perspective for understanding modernity and postmodernity. His life and work reflect the transition of intellectuals from academic philosophy to public engagement in the late 20th century.

self.zh: 解构不是摧毁，而是揭示文本中隐藏的矛盾和可能性。
self.en: Deconstruction is not destruction, but the revealing of contradictions and possibilities within texts.
